<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"

                  xmlns:tns="http://example.com/restaurant"
                  id="Definitions_Restaurant"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/restaurant">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Meal order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Payment" name="Payment"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Buzzer" name="Buzzer and instruction"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ChefOrder" name="New meal order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MealReady" name="Meal ready in service hatch"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BuzzerRing" name="Buzzer rings"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Call" name="Employee calls guest"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_GuestAtHatch" name="Guest appears at service hatch"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Restaurant">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Guest" name="Guest" processRef="Process_Guest"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Restaurant" name="Restaurant" processRef="Process_Restaurant"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Order" name="Place order" sourceRef="Guest_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Restaurant_ReceiveOrder" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Payment" name="Pay" sourceRef="Guest_Pay" targetRef="Restaurant_CollectPayment" messageRef="Message_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Buzzer" name="Pass buzzer and give instruction" sourceRef="Restaurant_PassBuzzer" targetRef="Guest_ReceiveBuzzer" messageRef="Message_Buzzer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ChefOrder" name="Inform chef of order" sourceRef="Restaurant_InformChef" targetRef="Restaurant_ChefReceiveOrder" messageRef="Message_ChefOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MealReady" name="Inform employee meal is ready" sourceRef="Restaurant_ChefInformReady" targetRef="Restaurant_ReceiveReady" messageRef="Message_MealReady"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BuzzerRing" name="Buzzer rings" sourceRef="Restaurant_RingBuzzer" targetRef="Guest_ReceiveRing" messageRef="Message_BuzzerRing"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Call" name="Call guest" sourceRef="Restaurant_CallGuest" targetRef="Guest_ReceiveCall" messageRef="Message_Call"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_GuestAtHatch" name="Guest appears at hatch" sourceRef="Guest_AppearAtHatch" targetRef="Restaurant_WaitForGuest" messageRef="Message_GuestAtHatch"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Guest" name="Guest meal purchase" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Guest_Hungry" name="Feels hungry"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Guest_Enter" name="Enter restaurant"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Guest_ChooseDish" name="Choose dish from meal range"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Guest_WaitTurn" name="Wait for turn"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Guest_PlaceOrder" name="Place order" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Guest_Pay" name="Pay for meal" messageRef="Message_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Guest_ReceiveBuzzer" name="Receive buzzer and instruction" messageRef="Message_Buzzer"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Guest_WaitForReady" name="Wait for readiness notification" eventGatewayType="Exclusive"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Guest_ReceiveRing" name="Hear buzzer ring" messageRef="Message_BuzzerRing"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Guest_ReceiveCall" name="Hear employee call" messageRef="Message_Call"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Guest_GoToHatch" name="Go to service hatch"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Guest_AppearAtHatch" name="Appear at service hatch" messageRef="Message_GuestAtHatch"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_2" sourceRef="Guest_Enter" targetRef="Guest_ChooseDish"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_3" sourceRef="Guest_ChooseDish" targetRef="Guest_WaitTurn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_4" sourceRef="Guest_WaitTurn" targetRef="Guest_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_5" sourceRef="Guest_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Guest_Pay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_6" sourceRef="Guest_Pay" targetRef="Guest_ReceiveBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_7" sourceRef="Guest_ReceiveBuzzer" targetRef="Guest_WaitForReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_8" sourceRef="Guest_WaitForReady" targetRef="Guest_ReceiveRing"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_9" sourceRef="Guest_WaitForReady" targetRef="Guest_ReceiveCall"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_10" sourceRef="Guest_ReceiveRing" targetRef="Guest_GoToHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_11" sourceRef="Guest_ReceiveCall" targetRef="Guest_GoToHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_12" sourceRef="Guest_GoToHatch" targetRef="Guest_AppearAtHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_13" sourceRef="Guest_AppearAtHatch" targetRef="Guest_ReceiveMeal"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_15" sourceRef="Guest_Eat" targetRef="Guest_End"/>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Restaurant_ReceiveOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Restaurant_EnterPOS</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Restaurant_CollectPayment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Restaurant_SetupBuzzer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Restaurant_PassBuzzer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Restaurant_InformChef</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Restaurant_ReceiveReady</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Restaurant_RingBuzzer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Restaurant_WaitForGuest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Restaurant_CallTimer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Restaurant_CallGuest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Restaurant_CallEnd</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Restaurant_HandOverMeal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Restaurant_End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Chef" name="Chef">

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Restaurant_PrepareMeal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Restaurant_PlaceInHatch</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Restaurant_ChefInformReady</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Restaurant_Start" name="Restaurant order flow begins"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Restaurant_ReceiveOrder" name="Receive meal order" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Restaurant_EnterPOS" name="Enter order into POS"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Restaurant_CollectPayment" name="Collect payment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Restaurant_SetupBuzzer" name="Set up buzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Restaurant_PassBuzzer" name="Pass buzzer and tell guest it will ring when dinner is ready" messageRef="Message_Buzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Restaurant_InformChef" name="Inform chef of new meal order" messageRef="Message_ChefOrder"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Restaurant_ChefReceiveOrder" name="Receive meal order" messageRef="Message_ChefOrder"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Restaurant_PrepareMeal" name="Prepare meal"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Restaurant_PlaceInHatch" name="Place meal in service hatch"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Restaurant_ChefInformReady" name="Inform employee meal is in service hatch" messageRef="Message_MealReady"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Restaurant_ReceiveReady" name="Receive meal-ready information" messageRef="Message_MealReady"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Restaurant_RingBuzzer" name="Set off guest's buzzer" messageRef="Message_BuzzerRing"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Restaurant_WaitForGuest" name="Wait for guest to appear at service hatch" messageRef="Message_GuestAtHatch"/>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Restaurant_CallTimer" name="Five minutes without response" attachedToRef="Restaurant_WaitForGuest" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">PT5M</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Restaurant_CallGuest" name="Call guest if necessary" messageRef="Message_Call">
      <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics testBefore="false">
        <bpmn:loopCondition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${guestHasNotResponded}</bpmn:loopCondition>
      </bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Restaurant_CallEnd" name="Calling complete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Restaurant_HandOverMeal" name="Hand meal to guest"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Restaurant_End" name="Meal handed over"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_1" sourceRef="Restaurant_Start" targetRef="Restaurant_ReceiveOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_2" sourceRef="Restaurant_ReceiveOrder" targetRef="Restaurant_EnterPOS"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_3" sourceRef="Restaurant_EnterPOS" targetRef="Restaurant_CollectPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_4" sourceRef="Restaurant_CollectPayment" targetRef="Restaurant_SetupBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_5" sourceRef="Restaurant_SetupBuzzer" targetRef="Restaurant_PassBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_6" sourceRef="Restaurant_PassBuzzer" targetRef="Restaurant_InformChef"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_7" sourceRef="Restaurant_InformChef" targetRef="Restaurant_ChefReceiveOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_8" sourceRef="Restaurant_ChefReceiveOrder" targetRef="Restaurant_PrepareMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_9" sourceRef="Restaurant_PrepareMeal" targetRef="Restaurant_PlaceInHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_10" sourceRef="Restaurant_PlaceInHatch" targetRef="Restaurant_ChefInformReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_11" sourceRef="Restaurant_ChefInformReady" targetRef="Restaurant_ReceiveReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_12" sourceRef="Restaurant_ReceiveReady" targetRef="Restaurant_RingBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_13" sourceRef="Restaurant_RingBuzzer" targetRef="Restaurant_WaitForGuest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_14" sourceRef="Restaurant_WaitForGuest" targetRef="Restaurant_HandOverMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_15" sourceRef="Restaurant_HandOverMeal" targetRef="Restaurant_End"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_16" sourceRef="Restaurant_CallTimer" targetRef="Restaurant_CallGuest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_17" sourceRef="Restaurant_CallGuest" targetRef="Restaurant_CallEnd"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
